rule_text:
Prototype 1 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EEG (67%), with EOG (21%) and EMG (12%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+0.4 dB, sensitivity=13.7) and elevated σ_h (+1.1 dB, sensitivity=7.0).
The δ activity is present in 21% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (REM 10% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with REM physiology: confirmed: EMG atonic, θ elevated; missing: EOG dominant. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for REM.
